title: Provenance
description: Contract 5: The citation and audit trail attached to any retrieval. Enables full traceability from answer back to source documents, including entities examined-but-not-cited (a novel audit signal for trajectory completeness).

source_documents.description: Source document ids cited by the retrieval results.

traversal_log.description: Ordered step-by-step log of entities visited during graph traversal.

visited_not_cited.description: Entities that were examined during traversal but did not make it into the final cited context. Comparing this against the traversal log yields a trajectory completeness score.

extraction_provenance.description: Mapping of graph elements (entities/relationships) to the text spans and source documents from which they were extracted.

total_entities_examined.description: Total number of entities visited during traversal.

total_chunks_examined.description: Total number of text chunks examined during retrieval.

total_chunks_returned.description: Total number of text chunks returned in the final context.

backend.description: Identifier of the backend that produced these results.

TraversalStep.description: A single step in the graph traversal audit log.

entity.description: Entity id visited at this step.

edge.description: Optional edge id traversed to reach this entity.

ExtractionRecord.description: Maps a graph element to its extraction provenance.

element_id.description: The entity or relationship id this record describes.

source_doc.description: The source document from which the element was extracted.

chunk_id.description: The text chunk id containing the extracted span.

extracted_text.description: The verbatim text span that justified extraction.
